Class GdalBand

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.gdal.GdalBand
public final class GdalBand extends Object
A band of a raster dataset: its pixels as Java arrays (row by row, the first row is the top), the no data value, the color table and the statistics. GDAL converts the pixels to the type of the array.

    • contours

      public void contours(VectorLayer target, double interval, String... options)
      Contour lines of the band into a vector layer (gdal_contour): the fields "ID" and "ELEV" are created if they don't exist; the no data value of the band is used. Further options of GDALContourGenerateEx, e.g. "LEVEL_BASE=100", "FIXED_LEVELS=500,1000", "POLYGONIZE=YES" (with "ELEV_FIELD_MIN=..." and "ELEV_FIELD_MAX=...").

    • polygonize

      public void polygonize(VectorLayer target, String field, boolean useMask, String... options)
      Polygons of the areas of equal values (gdal_polygonize) into a vector layer: the value of each polygon in the field (created if it doesn't exist: integer, or real for float bands). useMask: the pixels without data (the mask of the band) get no polygons. Options of GDALPolygonize, e.g. "8CONNECTED=8".
